policy.notes: A scheduled release requires approved=true, state=scheduled, a due ISO-8601 release_at value, an open non-draft PR, and the human-applied release-approved label.

releases.title: Realignment Architecture R1
releases.notes: Existing release PR is intentionally not scheduled by this file until a release time is added, approved is set true, state is set to scheduled, and the PR receives the release-approved label.
